notes.glasses: No sunglasses or reflective glasses. Clear glasses permitted if eyes unobscured.
notes.smile: Neutral face, closed mouth, facing camera squarely.
notes.ears: Traditional headwear allowed provided full face from forehead to chin is unobstructed.
notes.shadows: Crisp white background without casting shadows.
notes.babyRules: Baby photo must show upright head and open eyes against white backdrop.
